title: The augmented free complex of a hypercover
statement:
Let $U\to X$ be a split etale hypercover
[def-weil-pbc-finite-split-hypercover]. Write $\mathbb Z[V]$ for the
sheafification of the free abelian presheaf on the sheaf represented by an
etale $X$-scheme $V$. Then the alternating-face augmented complex

$$
 \cdots\longrightarrow\mathbb Z[U_2]\longrightarrow
 \mathbb Z[U_1]\longrightarrow\mathbb Z[U_0]
 \longrightarrow\mathbb Z[X]\longrightarrow0
$$

is exact. For an injective abelian sheaf $I$, its complex of sections
consequently satisfies $H^0(C^\bullet(U,I))=I(X)$ and
$H^p(C^\bullet(U,I))=0$ for $p>0$. The same assertions hold with free modules
over a constant ring.

proof.text: The degree-zero and positive-degree component theorems assemble via quasiIso_iff to prove the free abelian augmentation quasi-isomorphism.
The degree-zero injectivity and cycle-range component and positive-degree vanishing component are combined into the stated abelian section cohomology conjunction.
The degree-zero and positive-degree component theorems assemble via quasiIso_iff to prove the free module augmentation quasi-isomorphism.
The degree-zero module injectivity and cycle-range component and positive-degree vanishing component are combined into the stated module section cohomology conjunction.

theorem freeAbelian_augmentation_quasiIso
    {X : Scheme.{w}} [CompactSpace X] [QuasiSeparatedSpace X]
    (U : SplitEtaleHypercover X) :
    QuasiIso (AlgebraicTopology.AlternatingFaceMapComplex.ε.app
      ((SimplicialObject.Augmented.whiskeringObj X.Etale _
        (uliftYoneda.{w + 1} ⋙
          (Functor.whiskeringRight X.Etaleᵒᵖ (Type (w + 1)) AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1}).obj
            AddCommGrpCat.free ⋙
          presheafToSheaf X.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{w + 1})).obj
        (U.simplicial.augmentOfIsTerminal (terminalIsTerminal (C := X.Etale)))))
